nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Any idea what you're going to take photos of?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: None yet. Guess I'll just have to wander around until inspiration strikes me...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Isn't that what you artists do all the time anyway?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ha ha. Want to help?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I... Can't. I've got some business to take care of.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Aww... You sure?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: 'Fraid so. But I'll see you at the other end of this.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Don't worry! You'll do fine! You are by far the best photographer I know, even counting that old private eye I hired to take photos of all the people making out at Lookout Point.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...I'm kidding. That was a joke.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And I'm very, very relieved.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Seriously, don't worry. You've got this. There's no way you're going to lose.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Thanks, Wes.
You are now playing as Wes.
Moments later, Wes steps out of the gym, looks around to make sure no one's watching, and then ducks behind the building.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, there's no way she's going to lose... Because I'm not going to let her.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I didn't set this whole thing up so Autumn could lose to Lindsay `again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't set this whole thing up so Autumn could lose to Lindsay [color=#e23b3b][i]again![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm not `really` worried... Autumn really is great, and she'd probably win on her own merits...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] worried... Autumn really is great, and she'd probably win on her own merits...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But I didn't get where I am by taking chances.
Wes skulks through the empty school to his locker, where he reaches in and pulls away a false backing to reveal a hidden compartment full of tools!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Let's see here... Cell phone hacker... Hidden microphone... Wad of cash...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A-ha! Stink bomb! This should do nicely!
Wes pockets the small, tightly packed ball, and turns around, heading outside...
Where he spots Lindsay walking out to her fancy, new, bright red, sports car!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: She got that for her Sweet Sixteen... Because, you know, the world's a fair and just place.
Carefully pocketing the stink bomb, Wes strolls over. By her car, Lindsay is examining the high-end camera she got from the table...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh! How do I even make this piece of junk work?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: This is what the greats call a perfect opportunity. All I need to do is get close enough to plant the stink bomb behind her camera's shutter button...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Then, when she takes a photo, she'll get stinked, blame the camera, go home to change, and lose the tryouts.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: The trick is just finding a way to get close...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh really? You do 'winning'? Like how you won the Head Cheerleader position? Yeah, I read all about that online.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That's not the same thing at all! I was a Freshman! I wasn't eligible!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm sorry, did you say something? Because all I heard was a sore loser giving excuses.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What are you going to say when I crush you at this, Lindsay? 'Oh, it wasn't a fair contest, I don't do photography, wah wah wah'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I do not say 'wah wah wah'!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooo, Lindsay, are you making duck calls? Because I've gotta say, you are a `natural!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooo, Lindsay, are you making duck calls? Because I've gotta say, you are a [color=#e23b3b][i]natural![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I... I... I... Hmph! This is stupid! You're all stupid!
Lindsay storms off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That is one angry duck.
Wes strolls over, grinning.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wow, Autumn. I had no idea you had that level of mean girl in you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't! That's the first time I've ever done anything like that! My heart's still racing!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Sometimes, you just gotta stick up for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, well, as fun as that was, I really need to focus on getting this photo series done.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Oh, really? You're going to just ignore me? That's your new thing?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I kind of like it. This way, I won't have to hear you crying and whining when I crush you in these tryouts.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: You're pathetic, you know that? `Pathetic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're pathetic, you know that? [color=#3b78e2][i]Pathetic.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Lindsay turns and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooo! Are we playing the quiet game? I am `terrible` at it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooo! Are we playing the quiet game? I am [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible[/i][/color] at it!

nodes.text: Wes walks over, shaking his head...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I can appreciate trying to play it cool... But sometimes, you just gotta stand up for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... I know. But one battle at a time, okay? Right now, I really need to focus on getting this photo series done.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Enough chatter. I know that in the end, you are here because you are hungry for opportunity. And I shall not deny you the red meat your fangs so dearly crave.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I. Love. This. Guy.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: On the table to your left, you will find a high-end camera for each of you. Take this camera, and return to me by 3 o'clock with a photo series!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A series about what?

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: About anything, dear girl. Impress me. Surprise me. Challenge me.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Go forth... And make art!
Nikolai turns and retreats backstage. Autumn walks over to the table and picks up a camera...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: An incredible photo series due at 3 o'clock? That's, oh, you know, incredibly stressful...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Then why even bother, Art Dork? You're just going to lose.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Lindsay? You don't even do photography.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, but I `do` winning. And I'm going to destroy you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] winning. And I'm going to destroy you.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: No! Wrong! So wrong!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But... But that's the most interesting thing...

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: It's the most `sensational` thing. I am not some cheap paparazzo, some documenter of the flashy and vulgar!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the most [color=#e23b3b][i]sensational[/i][/color] thing. I am not some cheap paparazzo, some documenter of the flashy and vulgar!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is a paparazzo like a spicy cracker? Because I ate one once, and did `not` like it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is a paparazzo like a spicy cracker? Because I ate one once, and did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] like it!

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Any fool with a phone can take a photo of a car crash. Only a true artist can capture life!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, Autumn. Duh. Capture life.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Interesting choice. Explain why.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, you know, that's where the emotion is, right? The humanity. The story.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Yes! `Yes!` That is absolutely correct!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! [color=#e23b3b][i]Yes![/i][/color] That is absolutely correct!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Pffft. Lucky guess.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: No! Wrong! So wrong!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But... But it's pretty...

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: It is pedestrian! Mundane! Generic! Boring! Trite!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Funny! Silly! Goofy! Red!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are we... Are we not just saying adjectives? It seemed like we were just saying adjectives.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Any sap with a camera can take a photo of the moon. Only a true artist can capture life!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, Autumn. Duh. Capture life.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Uh... Trick question! I don't have my camera with me!

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Wrong on so many levels. A great photographer `always` has a camera with her!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My phone `is` a camera!

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: I am not here to befuddle you with cheap tricks! I am here to challenge you to capture life!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, Autumn. Duh. Capture life.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You either fit in perfectly with the cheerleaders and the jocks... Or you're a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sometimes I wish I was just, like, a normal teenage girl, into normal teenage things. It would make life so much easier.
Wes turns to Autumn, his head cocked to the side, an unusually serious expression on his face...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Naw. You don't mean that.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: People like you and me, Autumn? We're unique. We don't fit in, and we never will. We're just different. We're the square pegs in a world of round holes.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, sometimes life's harder for us...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But that just means it's gonna be that much more interesting.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Stay tough. Stay interesting. You'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Heh... You're surprisingly comforting, you know that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's amazing! I totally love it there!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yep! Just fine and dandy! Right as rain! Everything's totally perfect!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Really?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! I've got tons of friends, and everyone there is super into art and indie music and vintage clothing!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `...Really?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...Really?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Are you just going to keep saying 'really' until I admit I'm lying?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That was kind of the gameplan, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, fine. Things aren't going well at all.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I thought going to some big, fancy school would be better... But everyone there is just so competitive and intense all the time.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Honestly? Things aren't so good.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh? I'm sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I mean, it's not terrible or anything. No one's vandalized my art show or broken my mom's camera.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's kind of sad that that's where the bar is...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know. I guess I thought going to some big, fancy school would be better... But everyone there is just so competitive and intense all the time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Now then, I'm guessing you're here for the photography tryouts.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yep, that's right. Looks like you know everything, as always.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, it was either the photography tryouts or Spencer's corndog-eating contest, and you don't strike me as the corndog-eating type.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, now I'm offended! I'll have you know that I'm officially the number three corndog-eating champion in the county!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. I'm lying. I hate corndogs. I always feel like I'm eating styrofoam on a stick.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Heh. The photography talk is starting in the gym in ten minutes. Mind if I walk there with you?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Not at all!
Autumn and Wes stroll together across the Twin Branches campus...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So what are `you` doing here? Don't tell me you think you've got Spencer beat...
nodes.text_bbcode: So what are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here? Don't tell me you think you've got Spencer beat...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Not even a little. I'm actually helping $ZOE run her whole summer events program.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Really? I didn't think you were interested in... You know... Helping with things.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just much more complex than you thought.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How much is $ZOE paying you?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A hundred a week, just to convince people to show up to things. Talk about easy money...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Now `there's` the Wes I know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]there's[/i][/color] the Wes I know.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, well, the Wes you know has been a lot more bored since you transferred out of here. How are things going at your new school anyway?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They're... Um...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No. Don't be.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I am, Wes! I stood you up and never called you or anything. I just... I just ran.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm really, really sor--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I meant what I said, Autumn. You don't have anything to apologize for.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What Lindsay did was unforgivable. Don't worry, she'll get what she deserves. But you don't owe me or anyone else a thing.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You looked out for yourself. You survived. That's the smart thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Getting all sentimental, well, all that does is get people hurt. And that's the last I'll hear about it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Okay.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No. You didn't.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What Lindsay did to you was totally unforgivable, and she'll get what she deserves. But you couldn't stay here. I understand.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You looked out for yourself. You survived. That's the smart thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I stood you up and never called...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Water under the bridge. The past is the past.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Thanks for being so cool about this, Wes.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No worries.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. I can't answer. There's just too many bad memories there.
Autumn turns away from the phone and back to her webcam...
But she has no idea what she's done.
If she had answered the call, she would've had an amazing adventure, full of excitement and surprises and maybe a little romance...
But instead, she chose the safe option. The risk-free choice. The road most taken.
As a result, she made safe choices all her life. Even in college...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, I could be an art major, but that's just so risky... Who knows if I'll be able to get a good job?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Better to pick something safe and reliable... Like accounting!
Twenty years after that, against all odds, a reality TV star most famous for getting voted off seven separate shows ran for President...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Vote Ryan for Prez! I'll give every American a mansion and a swimming pool and a pony! Two ponies! `Three ponies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Vote Ryan for Prez! I'll give every American a mansion and a swimming pool and a pony! Two ponies! [color=#e23b3b][i]Three ponies![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Had Autumn gone into photography, she would've exposed Ryan as a sham with an incredible photo series...
But without her, a gullible American public fell for his promises, and voted him in.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Woohoo! I'm the President! As my first order, I declare that all Tuesdays will now be Taco Tuesdays!

nodes.speaker: Vice President
nodes.text: That's... Not really how it works, sir...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Who are you again?
Ryan enacted one terrible policy...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Health care? Boring! Stealth bear? Awesome!
After another...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I've got it! Federally-enforced Makeout Mondays! And yes, it's exactly what it sounds like!
After another.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Blech! This pasta is terrible! Declare war on Europe! Launch the stealth bears!
His policies turned America into a dystopia of poverty, crime, and everyone just feeling grossed out all the time.
A grown-up Autumn spoke about it on her holographic diary series...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The world is such a terrible place now... But I just don't know how this happened.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If only there was something I could have done differently...
But there was, Autumn. But there was.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Catch you later, art fans. I need to take this call.
Autumn closes her laptop and answers her phone.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn! Hey! It's been a while! How's it going at your new school?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's... Um... Okay. You know. Same old, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Well, the reason I'm calling is because I have an opportunity you might be interested in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See, my last duty as outgoing Social Chair is to plan the summer activities, and I was able to arrange for some pretty cool speakers to come by Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And tomorrow, we're having this famous photographer visit... Nikolai Tyrell. Have you heard of him?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: N... Nikolai Tyrell? `The` Nikolai Tyrell?
nodes.text_bbcode: N... Nikolai Tyrell? [color=#3b78e2][i]The[/i][/color] Nikolai Tyrell?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The photographer who won the 2012 Shutterbug award for his series on New York graffiti? Who covered the La Belle fashion show? Who single-handedly invented hipster filters?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess he's a big deal?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's the `biggest` deal! How did you swing this?
nodes.text_bbcode: He's the [color=#3b78e2][i]biggest[/i][/color] deal! How did you swing this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, well, perks of being the Social Chair, I guess. Anyway, he'll be at the school to talk, and I think he also said something about holding tryouts to be his summer intern.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's open to everyone who shows up. Is that something you'd be interested in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn? Are you there?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I... I'm here. I just can't believe it. A chance to be Nikolai Tyrell's summer intern? That's like a dream come true!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This isn't an elaborate prank, is it? Like I'm going to show up tomorrow, and you're all going to throw water balloons full of bees at me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I would never do that! Is that even a thing?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know! It just... This whole thing seems too good to be true! I mean, a chance to intern for my all-time favorite photographer? How does that even happen?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... Uh... Guess you're just lucky that way! I promise this isn't a prank or anything like that, Autumn. Do you want to come by?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Of course I'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! Bye, Autumn! See you soon!
Autumn hangs up. She turns back to her room...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, that was unexpected!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I hadn't planned on going back to Twin Branches... Not with everything that happened... But there's no way I can let an opportunity like this pass me by!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Besides, I'm probably just over-thinking things. It's not like Twin Branches is cursed or anything. There's plenty of nice people there. I'm sure everything will go just fine.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...I hope.
The next day, Autumn pulls into the Twin Branches High parking lot. As she steps out of the car, a familiar face walks over...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey there.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh! Wes! Hi!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's been a while.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, it has...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Last time we talked was the night of your art show. We were going to hang out afterwards, but then...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Then Lindsay trashed the place and broke my mom's camera...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That was the night I decided I had to leave Twin Branches... To get a new start somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, I... I know I kind of flaked on you... But you have to understand...

nodes.text: I just wish I knew what the other people trying out were up to...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ooooo, I get it!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...You do?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Taking pictures of the boys' locker room! A classic rite of passage for any young, blossoming woman!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wh... What... I... I don't...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, you don't have to explain! Believe me, I understand. Your body's changing. You're feeling all kinds of strange feelings. And you're just curious about what goes on with those crazy boys in their wacky locker room!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not like that, Ms. Lee, I swear! I mean, there aren't even any boys in here!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know! Unconventional, I'll admit, but who am I to judge? This way, you leave so much more to the imagination!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Still, you can't just go around taking pictures of the boy's locker room, not with today's uptight, stuffy standards! You need to learn about what's appropriate and inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You need... `The Talk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You need... [color=#3b78e2][i]The Talk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, no, really, if you'd just let me explain, I was taking photos to--

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Relax, Autumn, it's really okay! No one's judging you! In fact, this is a JFZ, a Judgement Free Zone! That's a term I just made up right there!
